synopsis: This title's real, well-documented content-evidence profile centers on profanity/racial-slur language and one plot-necessary violent scene, not sexual content. Multiple national news outlets confirm Biloxi, MS removed it from 8th-grade curriculum in October 2017 specifically over racial-slur language (it remained in the school library), and it has appeared on ALA's Frequently Challenged Books lists in 2011, 2017 (Top Ten), and the 2010-2019 decade Top 100, with slurs, a 'white savior' framing, and language cited as recurring reasons. Most recently, per PEN America, Leander ISD (TX) paused it in classroom use in Sept-Oct 2025 during an AI-assisted Texas SB 12 'DEI content' review; local news reports it was reinstated after the district revised curriculum materials. Despite the plot's rape-trial subject matter, no admissible source reviewed describes an on-page explicit sexual scene or sustained nudity, so sexually_explicit and both legal lenses are unsupported here. No match was found, in sources reviewed, on Moms for Liberty/BookLooks, Take Back the Classroom, or Utah/Florida state removal lists; South Carolina's State Board Instructional Materials Review Committee formally reviewed the title in 2024 under Regulation 43-170 and recommended it be RETAINED, not removed. Net: the documented risk surface here is language/racial-slur and general violence-in-plot history, corroborated by a state-level review that found no statutory violation -- not a sexual-content case.
